governance: Explicit player-prop direction plus stated line/price required. All Action Network analysts count as one correlated source family. Zero automatic game-side model or official-ledger impact.

sources.analyst: Sean Koerner / Grant Neiffer / Gilles Gallant

newStructuredRecords.summary: Andrei Iosivas: Under 1.5 receptions (-114, FanDuel). Iosivas had a 5% target rate under center and 8% against the blitz in 2025; Tampa Bay's Todd Bowles defense blitzes heavily, while added TE-heavy personnel could further reduce his routes and targets.

Braelon Allen: Over 17.5 rushing yards (-113, FanDuel). Allen is healthy and retains the early-down/short-yardage role; Breece Hall missed camp time, a competitive script creates more rushing opportunities, and Tennessee LB Cedric Gray is out.

D'Andre Swift: Under 14.5 rush attempts (-102, FanDuel). Kyle Monangai held a stable 10-11 carry role when active, Chicago uses designed receiver carries, and Carolina keeping the game competitive would cap Bears play volume.

Daniel Jones: Over 21.5 pass completions (-118, DraftKings). Returning from Achilles surgery may reduce Jones' scrambling and favor quick underneath throws; Baltimore's pass defense is changing schemes and Indianapolis has multiple short-area targets.

Cooper Rush: Under 18.5 pass completions (-120, DraftKings). Atlanta is expected to shift toward direct Bijan Robinson handoffs with Tua Tagovailoa out; a slow Pittsburgh pace, Rush's back spasms and possible Jack Strand relief all add downside to completions.

Tyler Shough: Over 16.5 rushing yards (-113, DraftKings). Taysom Hill's absence removes designed-QB-run competition; Detroit's man coverage and pressure can create scrambles, and a trailing game script can increase dropbacks.

Baker Mayfield: Over 0.5 interceptions (+100, bet365). Mayfield's 2025 interceptions materially trailed his turnover-worthy plays, while Cincinnati upgraded its defense and the matchup projects enough passing volume for regression toward his career interception rate.

newStructuredRecords.summary: Deshaun Watson: Under 19.5 rushing yards (-115, DraftKings); acceptable Under 18.5 at -110, not past -115. Watson returns from a twice-injured Achilles with little reason for designed runs; an injury-adjusted scramble-efficiency dock puts the analyst's median near 16.5 yards.

Joe Burrow: To throw an interception (+145, bet365). Tampa Bay's blitz-heavy approach, improved pass-rush personnel and a likely elevated Cincinnati pass rate create more pressure-driven turnover-worthy-play opportunities.

Bryce Young: To throw an interception (+120, bet365). Young's turnover-worthy-play rate rises against blitzes; Chicago blitzed at a top-10 rate and led the NFL in interceptions in 2025, while Carolina enters with offensive-line injuries.

Rico Dowdle: Anytime touchdown scorer (+120, DraftKings cited). Dowdle projects as Pittsburgh's early-down and goal-line back in Mike McCarthy's scheme, with Atlanta's backup-QB state supporting favorable Steelers scoring and rushing script.
